value.rationale: In a natural minimal network with competing edge reinforcements, the deterministic homogeneous long-run shares conceal increasingly negative unconditional count dependence. The exact parameter monotonicity is an all-time stochastic-order property, while sufficiently dominant central firing forces a limiting Pearson correlation of -1 despite positive endpoint immigration. This is a structural fluctuation/dependence phenomenon not a routine change of notation, finite enumeration, or unmotivated narrow invariant.
